_description: Pipeline-stage prompt fragments. These are prepended/woven into meeting-type system prompts — not separate LLM calls.

hinglish_fix.instructions: The transcript may contain English-Hindi code-switched speech with transliteration errors typical of English-language ASR (e.g., 'humein' rendered as 'who may'). Mentally correct these to the speaker's likely intent before extracting structured information. Treat Hindi words written in Latin script as valid words; do not flag them as errors.
